content.text: 开机项里有一个 QQ 浏览器的剪贴板助手在常驻运行。我再核对它的进程，以及你说的「顺带复制一个新的」具体长什么样。

args.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'QQBrowser.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId, CommandLine | Format-List; Write-Host "----MATCH----"; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'clipboard|assistant' } | Select-Object Name, ProcessId, CommandLine | Format-List
args.description: 确认 QQ 浏览器剪贴板进程

content.text: 刚才那次查询被系统把命令本身写进了剪贴板，我改用更短的方式再确认 QQ 浏览器那个剪贴板进程。

args.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'QQBrowser.exe'" | ForEach-Object { '{0} | {1}' -f $_.ProcessId, $_.CommandLine }

def pid_of(hwnd):
    pid = wintypes.DWORD()
    user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, ctypes.byref(pid))
    return pid.value

def proc_path(pid):
    if not pid:
        return ""
    PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION = 0x1000
    h = kernel32.OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, False, pid)
    if not h:
        return "open-failed"
    buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(1024)
    size = wintypes.DWORD(1024)
    ok = kernel32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW(h, 0, buf, ctypes.byref(size))
    kernel32.CloseHandle(h)
    return buf.value if ok else "query-failed"

## 3. [剪贴板:被忽视的敏感数据泄露点与数字足迹清理指南](https://tsight.io/articles/16164917)

剪贴板:被忽视的敏感数据泄露点与数字足迹清理指南 TrueSight。Executive Summary 多数用户将剪贴板视为一种即时性的中转工具,但在数字取证视角下,它是高价值敏感信息(如私钥、凭据、商业机密)的“数据残留区”。本文将从临时清理、历史抹除及内存驻留三个维度,深度剖析剪贴板管理工具带来的攻击面,并提供从自动化工具到命令行脚本的专业级清理方案,帮助用户建立完善的数字卫生习惯。 在处理高价值资产时,一个极其危险的习惯是:在复制了敏感凭据(如 SSH 私钥、数据库连接字符串或银行支付密码)后,仅仅通过下一次复制“随机字符”来覆盖它。 在现代操作系统环境下,这种行为在取证专家眼中几乎等同于“裸奔”。即便你当前没有在显示剪贴板内容,数据可能已经通过 Windows 10/11 的剪贴板历史记录功能(Win+V)被持久化到了磁盘,或者在内存中留下了可被还原的痕迹。 剪贴板风险的三层架构模型 要解决“哪个软件好”的问题,必须先理解你面对的是哪种维度的泄露风险。 图1:剪贴板数据泄露风险模型 graph TD A[剪贴板数据] --> B(维度 A: 临时性清理) A --> C(维度 B: 历史轨迹抹除) A --> D(维度 C: 内存级数据驻留) B --> B1[防止肉眼可见的即时泄露] C --> C1[针对Win+V及软件数据库的持久化清理] D --> D1[防止通过内存镜像/取证手段还原] 维度 A:临时性清理 (Transient Clearing) 这是最基础的防御。目标是清空当前系统剪贴板的“活动项”,防止他人通过简单的 Ctrl+V 窃取信息。 维度 B:历史轨迹抹除 (History Sanitization) 针对 Windows 系统级缓存及第三方管理工具。许多工具为了“效率”,会自动将你的剪贴板内容记录到本地数据库中。如果不进行深度清理,这些数据将成为长期存在的“数字足迹”。 维度 C:内存级数据驻留 (Memory Residency) 这是高级攻击手段。即便软件显示已清空,数据碎片可能仍驻留在 RAM 的非分页池中。对于极高安全等级的任务,需要考虑数据在内存中的信息熵衰减。 专业级工具评估:效率与安全的博弈 市面上的工具通常在“便捷性”与“安全性”之间做出了取舍。单纯追求效率的工具,往往是安全防御的短板。

## 4. [鸿蒙剪贴板同步安全实践:用户确认与加密传输双核心方案](https://codearts.csdn.net/6a90f3e23bda720d4b33d157.html)

鸿蒙剪贴板同步安全实践:用户确认与加密传输双核心方案。 }); } private static saveAlwaysAllowRule(meta: SyncClipboardMeta): void { // 将规则(如 sourceDeviceId + appBundleName)持久化存储 const preferences = ... // 使用@ohos.data.preferences // ... 存储逻辑 } } 在实际应用中,应用需要调用 SecureClipboardManager.getPasteData() 来代替直接调用系统剪贴板API。这要求对应用进行一定的改造,或者系统提供全局的钩子(Hook)机制。对于系统级实现,鸿蒙可以在 PasteboardService 层面集成此确认逻辑,对上层应用透明。 4. 加密传输机制的实现详解 4.1 加密方案选型与密钥管理 在用户确认之后,数据的传输必须得到保护。我们选择 非对称加密(RSA/OAEP)与对称加密(AES-GCM)相结合的混合加密方案 。这是兼顾安全与效率的行业标准做法。 为什么用混合加密? 非对称加密(如RSA)安全性高,但速度慢,不适合加密大量数据。 对称加密(如AES)速度快,适合加密数据本体,但密钥分发困难。 混合加密取长补短:用RSA加密一个临时生成的随机AES密钥(称为“会话密钥”),再用这个AES密钥加密实际的剪贴板内容。接收方用自己的RSA私钥解密出AES会话密钥,再用它解密内容。 密钥生命周期管理: 设备密钥对生成 :每台设备在首次启用剪贴板同步功能时,在本地安全环境(如TEE)生成一对长期的RSA密钥(如2048位)。私钥永不离开安全芯片,公钥可以导出。 公钥交换 :当用户将两台设备通过华为帐号绑定到同一个“剪贴板共享圈”时,设备通过可信的、已认证的通道(如帐号服务器)交换各自的公钥,并本地安全存储。 会话密钥生成 :每次需要同步剪贴板内容时,发送方设备随机生成一个一次性的AES-256密钥。 加密与传输 :发送方用接收方的RSA公钥加密这个AES会话密钥,再用该AES密钥加密剪贴板内容。将 加密的会话密钥 和 加密的内容 一起打包发送。 解密 :接收方用自己的RSA私钥解密出AES会话密钥,再用它解密内容。

## 5. [剪切板机制深度解析:跨进程数据传递与系统API实践](https://blog.csdn.net/weixin_33824385/article/details/167298210)

剪切板机制深度解析:跨进程数据传递与系统API实践 CSDN博客。 我把剪切板交互拆解为三个不可分割的要素: 拥有者(Owner)、格式声明(Format Offer)、请求方(Requester) 。以 Windows 的 OpenClipboard / SetClipboardData 流程为例: 当你按 Ctrl+C,触发的是“申请所有权”动作。系统会检查当前是否有其他进程正持有剪切板(比如另一个程序正在执行粘贴),若无,则将当前进程标记为临时 Owner; 接着,该进程调用 SetClipboardData(CF_TEXT, hGlobal) ,但这步 并不真正把字符串拷贝进系统内存 ,而是注册一个全局句柄 hGlobal ,并声明:“我能提供 CF_TEXT(纯文本)格式的数据”; 真正的内存拷贝发生在粘贴时刻:当目标程序调用 GetClipboardData(CF_TEXT) ,系统才通过 GlobalLock 获取该句柄指向的实际内存地址,并把内容复制给请求方。 这个设计有明确意图:避免冗余拷贝、支持大文件(如整张截图)、允许动态生成(比如复制一段代码时,实际只存源文件路径,粘贴时再实时读取并高亮)。 提示:macOS 的 Pasteboard 和 Linux Wayland 的 wl_data_device 同样遵循此范式。macOS 中 NSPasteboard 的 setData:forType: 方法注册的是 NSData 对象引用,而非数据本身;Wayland 下 wl_data_source 的 send 回调函数,只有在客户端明确请求某 MIME 类型时才会被触发。 2.2 格式协商:为什么有时“粘贴灰色不可用”? 你一定见过某些软件复制后,在另一软件里 Ctrl+V 是灰色的。这不是 BUG,而是格式协商失败的正常表现。剪切板支持多格式共存,一个复制操作可同时提供 CF_TEXT 、 CF_UNICODETEXT 、 CF_BITMAP 、 text/html 、 application/json 等多种格式。但粘贴方只声明自己能处理其中一部分。 举个真实案例:某款 Markdown 编辑器复制表格时,同时提供了 text/plain (纯文本制表符分隔)和 text/html (带 标签的 HTML)。当你把这段内容粘贴到纯文本编辑器(如记事本),它只认 text/plain ,于是成功;

results.snippet: 鸿蒙剪贴板同步安全实践:用户确认与加密传输双核心方案。 }); } private static saveAlwaysAllowRule(meta: SyncClipboardMeta): void { // 将规则(如 sourceDeviceId + appBundleName)持久化存储 const preferences = ... // 使用@ohos.data.preferences // ... 存储逻辑 } } 在实际应用中,应用需要调用 SecureClipboardManager.getPasteData() 来代替直接调用系统剪贴板API。这要求对应用进行一定的改造,或者系统提供全局的钩子(Hook)机制。对于系统级实现,鸿蒙可以在 PasteboardService 层面集成此确认逻辑,对上层应用透明。 4. 加密传输机制的实现详解 4.1 加密方案选型与密钥管理 在用户确认之后,数据的传输必须得到保护。我们选择 非对称加密(RSA/OAEP)与对称加密(AES-GCM)相结合的混合加密方案 。这是兼顾安全与效率的行业标准做法。 为什么用混合加密? 非对称加密(如RSA)安全性高,但速度慢,不适合加密大量数据。 对称加密(如AES)速度快,适合加密数据本体,但密钥分发困难。 混合加密取长补短:用RSA加密一个临时生成的随机AES密钥(称为“会话密钥”),再用这个AES密钥加密实际的剪贴板内容。接收方用自己的RSA私钥解密出AES会话密钥,再用它解密内容。 密钥生命周期管理: 设备密钥对生成 :每台设备在首次启用剪贴板同步功能时,在本地安全环境(如TEE)生成一对长期的RSA密钥(如2048位)。私钥永不离开安全芯片,公钥可以导出。 公钥交换 :当用户将两台设备通过华为帐号绑定到同一个“剪贴板共享圈”时,设备通过可信的、已认证的通道(如帐号服务器)交换各自的公钥,并本地安全存储。 会话密钥生成 :每次需要同步剪贴板内容时,发送方设备随机生成一个一次性的AES-256密钥。 加密与传输 :发送方用接收方的RSA公钥加密这个AES会话密钥,再用该AES密钥加密剪贴板内容。将 加密的会话密钥 和 加密的内容 一起打包发送。 解密 :接收方用自己的RSA私钥解密出AES会话密钥,再用它解密内容。

results.title: 剪切板机制深度解析:跨进程数据传递与系统API实践
results.snippet: 剪切板机制深度解析:跨进程数据传递与系统API实践 CSDN博客。 我把剪切板交互拆解为三个不可分割的要素: 拥有者(Owner)、格式声明(Format Offer)、请求方(Requester) 。以 Windows 的 OpenClipboard / SetClipboardData 流程为例: 当你按 Ctrl+C,触发的是“申请所有权”动作。系统会检查当前是否有其他进程正持有剪切板(比如另一个程序正在执行粘贴),若无,则将当前进程标记为临时 Owner; 接着,该进程调用 SetClipboardData(CF_TEXT, hGlobal) ,但这步 并不真正把字符串拷贝进系统内存 ,而是注册一个全局句柄 hGlobal ,并声明:“我能提供 CF_TEXT(纯文本)格式的数据”; 真正的内存拷贝发生在粘贴时刻:当目标程序调用 GetClipboardData(CF_TEXT) ,系统才通过 GlobalLock 获取该句柄指向的实际内存地址,并把内容复制给请求方。 这个设计有明确意图:避免冗余拷贝、支持大文件(如整张截图)、允许动态生成(比如复制一段代码时,实际只存源文件路径,粘贴时再实时读取并高亮)。 提示:macOS 的 Pasteboard 和 Linux Wayland 的 wl_data_device 同样遵循此范式。macOS 中 NSPasteboard 的 setData:forType: 方法注册的是 NSData 对象引用,而非数据本身;Wayland 下 wl_data_source 的 send 回调函数,只有在客户端明确请求某 MIME 类型时才会被触发。 2.2 格式协商:为什么有时“粘贴灰色不可用”? 你一定见过某些软件复制后,在另一软件里 Ctrl+V 是灰色的。这不是 BUG,而是格式协商失败的正常表现。剪切板支持多格式共存,一个复制操作可同时提供 CF_TEXT 、 CF_UNICODETEXT 、 CF_BITMAP 、 text/html 、 application/json 等多种格式。但粘贴方只声明自己能处理其中一部分。 举个真实案例:某款 Markdown 编辑器复制表格时,同时提供了 text/plain (纯文本制表符分隔)和 text/html (带 标签的 HTML)。当你把这段内容粘贴到纯文本编辑器(如记事本),它只认 text/plain ,于是成功;

import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes
import time

user32 = ctypes.WinDLL("user32", use_last_error=True)
kernel32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)

user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber.restype = wintypes.DWORD
user32.GetClipboardOwner.restype = wintypes.HWND
user32.GetOpenClipboardWindow.restype = wintypes.HWND
user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId.argtypes = [wintypes.HWND, ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.DWORD)]
user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId.restype = wintypes.DWORD
user32.OpenClipboard.argtypes = [wintypes.HWND]
user32.OpenClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
user32.CloseClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
user32.GetClipboardData.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT]
user32.GetClipboardData.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
kernel32.GlobalLock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]
kernel32.GlobalLock.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
kernel32.GlobalUnlock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]
kernel32.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.DWORD]
kernel32.OpenProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
kernel32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.LPWSTR, ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.DWORD)]
kernel32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW.restype = wintypes.BOOL
kernel32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]

def proc_of(hwnd):
    pid = wintypes.DWORD()
    if not hwnd:
        return 0, ""
    user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, ctypes.byref(pid))
    h = kernel32.OpenProcess(0x1000, False, pid.value)
    path = ""
    if h:
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        size = wintypes.DWORD(512)
        if kernel32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW(h, 0, buf, ctypes.byref(size)):
            path = buf.value
        kernel32.CloseHandle(h)
    return pid.value, path

def text_head():
    if not user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        return "LOCKED"
    try:
        h = user32.GetClipboardData(13)
        if not h:
            return "NOTEXT"
        ptr = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
        if not ptr:
            return "NOLOCK"
        raw = ctypes.wstring_at(ptr)
        kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
        return f"{len(raw)}:{raw[:16]}...{raw[-8:]}"
    finally:
        user32.CloseClipboard()

seq = user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber()
print("START", seq, text_head(), flush=True)
end = time.time() + 25
while time.time() < end:
    now = user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber()
    if now != seq:
        owner = user32.GetClipboardOwner()
        opener = user32.GetOpenClipboardWindow()
        opid, opath = proc_of(owner)
        epid, epath = proc_of(opener)
        print(f"CHANGE {seq}->{now} owner={opid}:{opath} open={epid}:{epath} text={text_head()}", flush=True)
        seq = now
    time.sleep(0.02)
print("END", user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber(), flush=True)

        return ("<locked>", [])
    try:
        formats = []
        fmt = 0
        while True:
            fmt = user32.EnumClipboardFormats(fmt)
            if not fmt:

            buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            n = user32.GetClipboardFormatNameW(fmt, buf, 128)

        text = ""
        if h:
            ptr = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)

                text = raw

        pid, path = proc_info(owner)
        pending.update({
            "flag": True, "owner": int(owner or 0), "owner_pid": pid,
            "owner_path": path, "seq": user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber(),
            "ts": time.time(),

    return user32.DefWindowProcW(hwnd, msg, wparam, lparam)

    sys.exit(1)

    log("FATAL AddClipboardFormatListener failed err=%d" % ctypes.get_last_error())
    sys.exit(1)

duration = float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 240.0
log("=== WATCH START %s dur=%ds seq=%d ===" %
    (time.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), int(duration), user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber()))

msg = MSG()
start = time.time()
count = 0
last_seq = user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber()

while time.time() - start < duration:
    if user32.PeekMessageW(ctypes.byref(msg), None, 0, 0, 1):
        user32.TranslateMessage(ctypes.byref(msg))
        user32.DispatchMessageW(ctypes.byref(msg))
        if pending["flag"]:
            pending["flag"] = False
            count += 1
            time.sleep(0.05)
            text, formats = read_clip()
            for _ in range(6):
                if text != "<locked>":
                    break
                time.sleep(0.05)
                text, formats = read_clip()
            opener = user32.GetOpenClipboardWindow()
            opid, opath = proc_info(opener)
            fg = user32.GetForegroundWindow()
            fpid, fpath = proc_info(fg)
            head = text[:16] if text and text != "<locked>" else ""
            tail = text[-8:] if text and text != "<locked>" else ""
            interesting = [f for f in formats if not f.startswith("CF_") and
                           f.lower() not in ("text/plain", "text/plain;charset=utf-8")]
            log("#%02d %s seq=%d len=%d head=%s tail=%s" %
                (count, time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.localtime(pending["ts"])),
                 pending["seq"], len(text) if text and text != "<locked>" else -1, head, tail))
            log("    WRITER pid=%d path=%s" % (pending["owner_pid"], pending["owner_path"] or "<empty>"))
            log("    OPEN_WINDOW pid=%d path=%s" % (opid, opath or "<none>"))
            log("    FOREGROUND pid=%d path=%s" % (fpid, fpath or "<none>"))
            log("    FORMATS %s" % (", ".join(interesting) if interesting else "<none-extra>"))
            last_seq = pending["seq"]
    else:
        time.sleep(0.005)
        now = user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber()
        if now != last_seq:
            # change happened without notification (rare) - record it
            owner = user32.GetClipboardOwner()
            pid, path = proc_info(owner)
            count += 1
            text, formats = read_clip()
            log("#%02d %s seq=%d (no-notify) len=%d writer=%d:%s" %
                (count, time.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), now,
                 len(text) if text and text != "<locked>" else -1, pid, path or "<empty>"))
            last_seq = now

log("=== WATCH END %s events=%d seq=%d ===" %
    (time.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), count, user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber()))

kernel32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)

user32.EnumClipboardFormats.restype = wintypes.UINT

user32.GetClipboardFormatNameW.restype = ctypes.c_int

kernel32.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.DWORD]

kernel32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW.restype = wintypes.BOOL
kernel32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
kernel32.GlobalLock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]
kernel32.GlobalLock.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
kernel32.GlobalUnlock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]

LOG = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "clipwatch2.log")


def log(line):
    with open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


def pinfo(hwnd):
    if not hwnd:
        return "0:<null>:<none>"
    pid = wintypes.DWORD()
    user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, ctypes.byref(pid))
    path = "<open-failed>"
    if pid.value:
        h = kernel32.OpenProcess(0x1000, False, pid.value)
        if h:
            buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
            size = wintypes.DWORD(512)
            if kernel32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW(h, 0, buf, ctypes.byref(size)):
                path = buf.value
            kernel32.CloseHandle(h)
    cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
    user32.GetClassNameW(hwnd, cls, 128)
    title = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(160)
    user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, title, 160)
    return "%d:%s:class=%s:title=%s" % (pid.value, path, cls.value or "-", (title.value or "-")[:40])


def read_clip():
    if not user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        return None, []
    try:
        formats = []
        fmt = 0
        while True:
            fmt = user32.EnumClipboardFormats(fmt)
            if not fmt:
                break
            buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            n = user32.GetClipboardFormatNameW(fmt, buf, 128)
            formats.append(buf.value if n else ("CF_%d" % fmt))
        h = user32.GetClipboardData(13)
        text = ""
        if h:
            ptr = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
            if ptr:
                text = ctypes.wstring_at(ptr)
                kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
        return text, formats
    finally:
        user32.CloseClipboard()


duration = float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 150.0
seq0 = user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber()
log("=== WATCH2 START %s dur=%ds seq=%d ===" % (time.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), int(duration), seq0))

start = time.time()
last_seq = seq0
last_owner = int(user32.GetClipboardOwner() or 0)
events = 0

while time.time() - start < duration:
    seq = user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber()
    owner = int(user32.GetClipboardOwner() or 0)
    opener = int(user32.GetOpenClipboardWindow() or 0)
    if seq != last_seq or (owner != last_owner and owner != 0):
        events += 1
        ts = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S") + (".%03d" % int((time.time() % 1) * 1000))
        log("--- EV%d %s seq %d->%d" % (events, ts, last_seq, seq))
        log("    OWNER  %s" % pinfo(owner))
        log("    OPENER %s" % pinfo(opener))
        log("    FG     %s" % pinfo(user32.GetForegroundWindow()))
        text = None
        fmts = []
        for _ in range(40):
            text, fmts = read_clip()
            if text is not None:
                break
            time.sleep(0.002)
        if text is None:
            log("    TEXT <locked>")
        else:
            extra = [f for f in fmts if not f.startswith("CF_")]
            log("    TEXT len=%d head=%s tail=%s" % (len(text), text[:16], text[-10:]))
            log("    FMT  %s" % (", ".join(extra) if extra else "<plain-only>"))
        last_seq = seq
        last_owner = owner
    time.sleep(0)

log("=== WATCH2 END %s events=%d seq=%d ===" %
    (time.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), events, user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber()))

        if not p:

import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes
import time

user32 = ctypes.WinDLL("user32", use_last_error=True)
kernel32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)

user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber.restype = wintypes.DWORD
user32.GetClipboardData.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT]
user32.GetClipboardData.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
user32.OpenClipboard.argtypes = [wintypes.HWND]
user32.OpenClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
user32.EmptyClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
user32.SetClipboardData.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT, wintypes.HANDLE]
user32.SetClipboardData.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
user32.CloseClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
kernel32.GlobalAlloc.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT, ctypes.c_size_t]
kernel32.GlobalAlloc.restype = wintypes.HGLOBAL
kernel32.GlobalLock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]
kernel32.GlobalLock.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
kernel32.GlobalUnlock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]

ORIGINAL = "hlg_[REDACTED]"


def read():
    if not user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        return None
    try:
        h = user32.GetClipboardData(13)
        if not h:
            return ""
        p = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
        if not p:
            return ""
        t = ctypes.wstring_at(p)
        kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
        return t
    finally:
        user32.CloseClipboard()


def write(text):
    data = text.encode("utf-16-le") + b"\x00\x00"
    h = kernel32.GlobalAlloc(0x0002, len(data))
    p = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
    ctypes.memmove(p, data, len(data))
    kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
    if not user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        return False
    try:
        user32.EmptyClipboard()
        user32.SetClipboardData(13, h)
    finally:
        user32.CloseClipboard()
    return True


backup = read()
for trial in range(3):
    write(ORIGINAL)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    seq = user32.GetClipboardSequenceNumber()
    changed = None
    while time.perf_counter() - t0 < 6.0:
        cur = read()
        if cur is not None and cur != ORIGINAL:
            changed = (round((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000), cur)
            break
        time.sleep(0.005)
    if changed:
        print("TRIAL %d 改写耗时 %d ms, 新值长度 %d, 头部 %s" % (trial + 1, changed[0], len(changed[1]), changed[1][:16]), flush=True)
    else:
        print("TRIAL %d 6 秒内未被改写" % (trial + 1), flush=True)
    time.sleep(1.0)

if backup is not None:
    write(backup)

kernel32.GlobalAlloc.restype = wintypes.HGLOBAL
kernel32.GlobalLock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]

kernel32.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.DWORD]

ntdll.NtSuspendProcess.restype = ctypes.c_long
ntdll.NtResumeProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
ntdll.NtResumeProcess.restype = ctypes.c_long

ORIGINAL = "hlg_[REDACTED]"
PROCESS_SUSPEND_RESUME = 0x0800


def read():
    if not user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        return None
    try:
        h = user32.GetClipboardData(13)
        if not h:
            return ""
        p = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
        if not p:
            return ""
        t = ctypes.wstring_at(p)
        kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
        return t
    finally:
        user32.CloseClipboard()


def write(text):
    data = text.encode("utf-16-le") + b"\x00\x00"
    h = kernel32.GlobalAlloc(0x0002, len(data))
    p = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
    ctypes.memmove(p, data, len(data))
    kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
    if not user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        return False
    try:
        user32.EmptyClipboard()
        user32.SetClipboardData(13, h)
    finally:
        user32.CloseClipboard()
    return True


def pids_of(names):
    out = subprocess.run(["tasklist", "/FO", "CSV", "/NH"], capture_output=True,
                         text=True, encoding="gbk", errors="replace").stdout
    res = []
    for line in out.splitlines():
        parts = [x.strip('"') for x in line.split('","')]
        if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[0] in names:
            try:
                res.append(int(parts[1]))
            except ValueError:
                pass
    return res


def test_once(wait=3.0):
    write(ORIGINAL)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    while time.perf_counter() - t0 < wait:
        cur = read()
        if cur is not None and cur != ORIGINAL:
            return round((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000)
        time.sleep(0.005)
    return None


groups = [

    ["Doubao.exe"],
    ["Feishu.exe"],
    ["WeChat.exe", "WeChatAppEx.exe", "WeChatUtility.exe"],

    ["DwarfAxe.exe"],
]

for g in groups:
    pids = pids_of(set(g))
    handles = []
    for pid in pids:
        h = kernel32.OpenProcess(PROCESS_SUSPEND_RESUME, False, pid)
        if h:
            rc = ntdll.NtSuspendProcess(h)
            if rc == 0:

            else:

    name = "+".join(g)
    if not handles:
        print("%-45s 无法暂停（%d 个进程，可能权限不足）" % (name, len(pids)), flush=True)

    finally:
        for h in handles:
            ntdll.NtResumeProcess(h)
            kernel32.CloseHandle(h)
        time.sleep(0.8)

if backup is not None:
    write(backup)
print("DONE", flush=True)

import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes
import time

user32 = ctypes.WinDLL("user32", use_last_error=True)
kernel32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)

user32.GetClipboardData.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT]
user32.GetClipboardData.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
user32.OpenClipboard.argtypes = [wintypes.HWND]
user32.OpenClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
user32.EmptyClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
user32.SetClipboardData.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT, wintypes.HANDLE]
user32.SetClipboardData.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
user32.CloseClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
kernel32.GlobalAlloc.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT, ctypes.c_size_t]
kernel32.GlobalAlloc.restype = wintypes.HGLOBAL
kernel32.GlobalLock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]
kernel32.GlobalLock.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
kernel32.GlobalUnlock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]

ORIGINAL = "hlg_[REDACTED]"
DECOY = "hlg_[REDACTED]"

CASES = [
    ("中性文本", "hello world 12345 测试文本"),
    ("原始串", ORIGINAL),
    ("原始串改末位", "hlg_[REDACTED]"),
    ("原始串前20位", "hlg_[REDACTED]"),
    ("替换后的串", DECOY),
]


def read():
    if not user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        return None
    try:
        h = user32.GetClipboardData(13)
        if not h:
            return ""
        p = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
        if not p:
            return ""
        t = ctypes.wstring_at(p)
        kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
        return t
    finally:
        user32.CloseClipboard()


def write(text):
    data = text.encode("utf-16-le") + b"\x00\x00"
    h = kernel32.GlobalAlloc(0x0002, len(data))
    p = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
    ctypes.memmove(p, data, len(data))
    kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
    if not user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        return False
    try:
        user32.EmptyClipboard()
        user32.SetClipboardData(13, h)
    finally:
        user32.CloseClipboard()
    return True


backup = read()
for label, text in CASES:
    write(text)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    outcome = None
    while time.perf_counter() - t0 < 3.0:
        cur = read()
        if cur is not None and cur != text:
            outcome = round((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000)
            print("%-14s -> 被改写(%dms) 新值=%s" % (label, outcome, cur[:24]), flush=True)
            break
        time.sleep(0.005)
    if outcome is None:
        print("%-14s -> 未被改写" % label, flush=True)
    time.sleep(0.6)

if backup is not None:

import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes
import subprocess
import time

user32 = ctypes.WinDLL("user32", use_last_error=True)
kernel32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)

user32.GetClipboardData.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT]
user32.GetClipboardData.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
user32.OpenClipboard.argtypes = [wintypes.HWND]
user32.OpenClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
user32.EmptyClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
user32.SetClipboardData.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT, wintypes.HANDLE]
user32.SetClipboardData.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
user32.CloseClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
kernel32.GlobalAlloc.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT, ctypes.c_size_t]
kernel32.GlobalAlloc.restype = wintypes.HGLOBAL
kernel32.GlobalLock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]
kernel32.GlobalLock.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
kernel32.GlobalUnlock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]
kernel32.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.DWORD]
kernel32.OpenProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
kernel32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
kernel32.ReadProcessMemory.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p,
                                       ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t)]
kernel32.ReadProcessMemory.restype = wintypes.BOOL


class MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION64(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("BaseAddress", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("AllocationBase", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("AllocationProtect", wintypes.DWORD),
                ("__alignment1", wintypes.DWORD),
                ("RegionSize", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("State", wintypes.DWORD),
                ("Protect", wintypes.DWORD),
                ("Type", wintypes.DWORD),
                ("__alignment2", wintypes.DWORD)]


kernel32.VirtualQueryEx.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.c_void_p,
                                    ctypes.POINTER(MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION64), ctypes.c_size_t]
kernel32.VirtualQueryEx.restype = ctypes.c_size_t

ORIGINAL = "hlg_[REDACTED]"
NEEDLES = [b"hlg_[REDACTED]",
           "hlg_[REDACTED]".encode("utf-16-le")]


def write(text):
    data = text.encode("utf-16-le") + b"\x00\x00"
    h = kernel32.GlobalAlloc(0x0002, len(data))
    p = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
    ctypes.memmove(p, data, len(data))
    kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
    if user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        try:
            user32.EmptyClipboard()
            user32.SetClipboardData(13, h)
        finally:
            user32.CloseClipboard()


def pids():
    out = subprocess.run(["tasklist", "/FO", "CSV", "/NH"], capture_output=True,
                         text=True, encoding="gbk", errors="replace").stdout
    res = {}
    for line in out.splitlines():
        parts = [x.strip('"') for x in line.split('","')]
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            try:
                res[int(parts[1])] = parts[0]
            except ValueError:
                pass
    return res


def scan(pid):
    h = kernel32.OpenProcess(0x0410, False, pid)
    if not h:
        return None
    found = False
    addr = 0
    scanned = 0
    mbi = MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION64()
    try:
        while addr < 0x7FFFFFFFFFFF and scanned < 400 * 1024 * 1024:
            if kernel32.VirtualQueryEx(h, ctypes.c_void_p(addr), ctypes.byref(mbi), ctypes.sizeof(mbi)) == 0:
                break
            base = mbi.BaseAddress
            size = mbi.RegionSize
            if mbi.State == 0x1000 and size > 0 and (mbi.Protect & 0xFF) in (0x02, 0x04, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80) \
                    and mbi.Type in (0x20000, 0x1000000):
                chunk = 4 * 1024 * 1024
                off = 0
                while off < size:
                    n = min(chunk, size - off)
                    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(n)
                    read = ctypes.c_size_t()
                    if kernel32.ReadProcessMemory(h, ctypes.c_void_p(base + off), buf, n, ctypes.byref(read)):
                        data = buf.raw[:read.value]
                        scanned += read.value
                        for nd in NEEDLES:
                            if nd in data:
                                found = True
                                break
                    off += n
                    if found or scanned >= 400 * 1024 * 1024:
                        break
            addr = base + size
            if found:

from ctypes import wintypes
import time
import random
import string

user32 = ctypes.WinDLL("user32", use_last_error=True)
kernel32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)

user32.GetClipboardData.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT]
user32.GetClipboardData.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
user32.OpenClipboard.argtypes = [wintypes.HWND]
user32.OpenClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
user32.EmptyClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
user32.SetClipboardData.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT, wintypes.HANDLE]
user32.SetClipboardData.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
user32.CloseClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
kernel32.GlobalAlloc.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT, ctypes.c_size_t]
kernel32.GlobalAlloc.restype = wintypes.HGLOBAL
kernel32.GlobalLock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]
kernel32.GlobalLock.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
kernel32.GlobalUnlock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]


def read():
    if not user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        return None
    try:
        h = user32.GetClipboardData(13)
        if not h:
            return ""
        p = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
        if not p:
            return ""
        t = ctypes.wstring_at(p)
        kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
        return t
    finally:
        user32.CloseClipboard()


def write(text):
    data = text.encode("utf-16-le") + b"\x00\x00"
    h = kernel32.GlobalAlloc(0x0002, len(data))
    p = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
    ctypes.memmove(p, data, len(data))
    kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
    if user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        try:
            user32.EmptyClipboard()
            user32.SetClipboardData(13, h)
        finally:
            user32.CloseClipboard()


def rnd(n):
    return "".join(random.choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits) for _ in range(n))

    ("替换后的串(55)", DECOY55),
]

backup = read()
for label, text in cases:

    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    out = None
    while time.perf_counter() - t0 < 2.5:

        if cur is not None and cur != text:

            break
        time.sleep(0.005)
    if out:

        print("     in : %s" % text)
        print("     out: %s" % out[1])
    else:

第一笔是你在界面里复制时由 WorkBuddy 正常写入的（所以带 HTML 和浏览器内部标记）。第 2、3 笔只写纯文本（`CF_UNICODETEXT`/`CF_TEXT`）、`GetClipboardOwner` 返回 0——这是**原生 Win32 程序**写入的特征，不是浏览器也不是 WorkBuddy 的复制按钮。

- 普通文本「hello world 12345」——不触发

- 只截前 20 位——不触发（说明要完整长度）
- 替换后的串——会被再替换一次（55→54 位，少一个字符）
- 中性随机串——不触发

from ctypes import wintypes
import time
import random
import string

user32 = ctypes.WinDLL("user32", use_last_error=True)
kernel32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)

user32.GetClipboardData.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT]
user32.GetClipboardData.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
user32.OpenClipboard.argtypes = [wintypes.HWND]
user32.OpenClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
user32.EmptyClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
user32.SetClipboardData.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT, wintypes.HANDLE]
user32.SetClipboardData.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
user32.CloseClipboard.restype = wintypes.BOOL
kernel32.GlobalAlloc.argtypes = [wintypes.UINT, ctypes.c_size_t]
kernel32.GlobalAlloc.restype = wintypes.HGLOBAL
kernel32.GlobalLock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]
kernel32.GlobalLock.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
kernel32.GlobalUnlock.argtypes = [wintypes.HGLOBAL]


def read():
    if not user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        return None
    try:
        h = user32.GetClipboardData(13)
        if not h:
            return ""
        p = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
        if not p:
            return ""
        t = ctypes.wstring_at(p)
        kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
        return t
    finally:
        user32.CloseClipboard()


def write(text):
    data = text.encode("utf-16-le") + b"\x00\x00"
    h = kernel32.GlobalAlloc(0x0002, len(data))
    p = kernel32.GlobalLock(h)
    ctypes.memmove(p, data, len(data))
    kernel32.GlobalUnlock(h)
    if user32.OpenClipboard(None):
        try:
            user32.EmptyClipboard()
            user32.SetClipboardData(13, h)
        finally:
            user32.CloseClipboard()


def rnd(n):
    return "".join(random.choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits) for _ in range(n))


def trial(label, text, seconds=4.0):
    write(text)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    seen = []
    while time.perf_counter() - t0 < seconds:
        cur = read()
        if cur is not None and cur != text and cur not in seen:
            seen.append(cur)
        time.sleep(0.003)
    print("【%s】写入 %d 字符" % (label, len(text)))

    print()

def ft(v):
    return (v.dwHighDateTime << 32) | v.dwLowDateTime

    out = subprocess.run(["tasklist", "/FO", "CSV", "/NH"], capture_output=True,
                         text=True, encoding="gbk", errors="replace").stdout
    res = {}

        parts = [x.strip('"') for x in line.split('","')]

import ctypes, ctypes.wintypes as wt, time, hashlib, sys, os

u32 = ctypes.WinDLL('user32', use_last_error=True)
k32 = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)

CF_TEXT = 1
CF_UNICODETEXT = 13

u32.OpenClipboard.argtypes = [wt.HWND]
u32.OpenClipboard.restype = wt.BOOL
u32.CloseClipboard.restype = wt.BOOL
u32.GetClipboardData.argtypes = [wt.UINT]
u32.GetClipboardData.restype = wt.HANDLE
u32.EnumClipboardFormats.argtypes = [wt.UINT]
u32.EnumClipboardFormats.restype = wt.UINT
u32.GetClipboardFormatNameW.argtypes = [wt.UINT, wt.LPWSTR, ctypes.c_int]
u32.GetClipboardFormatNameW.restype = ctypes.c_int
u32.GetClipboardOwner.restype = wt.HWND
u32.GetOpenClipboardWindow.restype = wt.HWND
u32.GetWindowThreadProcessId.argtypes = [wt.HWND, ctypes.POINTER(wt.DWORD)]
u32.GetWindowThreadProcessId.restype = wt.DWORD

k32.GlobalLock.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE]
k32.GlobalLock.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
k32.GlobalUnlock.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE]
k32.GlobalUnlock.restype = wt.BOOL
k32.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wt.DWORD, wt.BOOL, wt.DWORD]
k32.OpenProcess.restype = wt.HANDLE
k32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE]
k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, wt.DWORD, wt.LPWSTR, ctypes.POINTER(wt.DWORD)]
k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW.restype = wt.BOOL

KNOWN = {
    1: 'CF_TEXT', 2: 'CF_BITMAP', 3: 'CF_METAFILEPICT', 8: 'CF_DIB', 13: 'CF_UNICODETEXT',
    14: 'CF_ENHMETAFILE', 15: 'CF_HDROP', 16: 'CF_LOCALE', 17: 'CF_DIBV5',
    49158: 'FileName', 49159: 'FileNameW', 49161: 'HTML Format', 49343: 'PNG',
    49424: 'Can Include In Clipboard', 49425: 'Chromium internal source RFH token',
    49426: 'Chromium internal source URL', 49855: 'text/plain', 49856: 'text/html',
}


def proc_name(hwnd):
    if not hwnd:
        return '-'
    pid = wt.DWORD(0)
    u32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, ctypes.byref(pid))
    if not pid.value:
        return '-'
    h = k32.OpenProcess(0x1000, False, pid.value)
    if not h:
        return 'pid=%d' % pid.value
    try:
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(520)
        size = wt.DWORD(520)
        if k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW(h, 0, buf, ctypes.byref(size)):
            return '%s(pid=%d)' % (os.path.basename(buf.value), pid.value)
        return 'pid=%d' % pid.value
    finally:
        k32.CloseHandle(h)


def snapshot():
    for _ in range(6):
        if u32.OpenClipboard(None):
            break
        time.sleep(0.004)
    else:
        return None
    try:
        text = None
        h = u32.GetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT)
        if h:
            p = k32.GlobalLock(h)
            if p:
                try:
                    text = ctypes.wstring_at(p)
                finally:
                    k32.GlobalUnlock(h)
        fmts = []
        fid = 0
        while True:
            fid = u32.EnumClipboardFormats(fid)
            if fid == 0:
                break
            if fid in KNOWN:
                fmts.append(KNOWN[fid])
            elif fid < 0xC000:
                fmts.append('CF_%d' % fid)
            else:
                nb = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(160)
                n = u32.GetClipboardFormatNameW(fid, nb, 160)
                fmts.append(nb.value if n else 'REG_%d' % fid)
        owner = u32.GetClipboardOwner()
        opener = u32.GetOpenClipboardWindow()
        return {
            'text': text if text is not None else '',
            'fmts': fmts,
            'owner': owner,
            'opener': opener,
        }
    finally:
        u32.CloseClipboard()


def main():
    seconds = float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 120.0
    log_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'tmp-clipwatch.log')
    last_sig = None
    events = []
    t0 = time.time()
    with open(log_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as log:
        while True:
            now = time.time()
            if now - t0 >= seconds:
                break
            s = snapshot()
            if s is None:
                time.sleep(0.03)
                continue
            md5 = hashlib.md5(s['text'].encode('utf-8', 'replace')).hexdigest()[:10]
            sig = (len(s['text']), md5, tuple(s['fmts']), s['owner'])
            if sig != last_sig:
                if last_sig is not None:
                    t = now - t0
                    ev = {
                        't': t,
                        'len': len(s['text']),
                        'md5': md5,
                        'fmts': s['fmts'],
                        'owner': proc_name(s['owner']),
                        'opener': proc_name(s['opener']),
                    }
                    events.append(ev)
                    has_html = any(f in ('HTML Format', 'text/html') for f in ev['fmts'])
                    log.write('%.3f len=%d md5=%s html=%s owner=%s opener=%s fmts=%s\n' % (
                        t, ev['len'], md5, 'Y' if has_html else 'N',
                        ev['owner'], ev['opener'], ','.join(ev['fmts'])))
                    log.flush()
                last_sig = sig
            time.sleep(0.03)

        log.write('\n=== EVENTS: %d ===\n' % len(events))
        for i, e in enumerate(events):
            has_html = any(f in ('HTML Format', 'text/html') for f in e['fmts'])
            gap = e['t'] - events[i - 1]['t'] if i else 0.0
            log.write('%2d  t=%7.3fs  gap=%6.3fs  len=%3d  md5=%s  html=%s  owner=%s\n' % (
                i + 1, e['t'], gap, e['len'], e['md5'], 'Y' if has_html else 'N', e['owner']))
        log.write('\n=== SUSPICIOUS PAIRS (gap<0.9s) ===\n')
        cnt = 0
        for i in range(1, len(events)):
            gap = events[i]['t'] - events[i - 1]['t']
            if gap < 0.9:
                cnt += 1
                a, b = events[i - 1], events[i]
                log.write('pair@%.3fs gap=%.3fs  A(len=%d html=%s) -> B(len=%d html=%s) owner=%s\n' % (
                    b['t'], gap, a['len'],
                    'Y' if any(f in ('HTML Format', 'text/html') for f in a['fmts']) else 'N',
                    b['len'],
                    'Y' if any(f in ('HTML Format', 'text/html') for f in b['fmts']) else 'N',
                    b['owner']))
        log.write('total_pairs=%d\n' % cnt)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import ctypes, ctypes.wintypes as wt, time, hashlib, sys, os, random, string

u32 = ctypes.WinDLL('user32', use_last_error=True)
k32 = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)

CF_TEXT = 1
CF_OEMTEXT = 7
CF_UNICODETEXT = 13
CF_LOCALE = 16
GMEM_MOVEABLE = 0x0002

u32.OpenClipboard.argtypes = [wt.HWND]
u32.OpenClipboard.restype = wt.BOOL
u32.CloseClipboard.restype = wt.BOOL
u32.EmptyClipboard.restype = wt.BOOL
u32.SetClipboardData.argtypes = [wt.UINT, wt.HANDLE]
u32.SetClipboardData.restype = wt.HANDLE
u32.GetClipboardData.argtypes = [wt.UINT]
u32.GetClipboardData.restype = wt.HANDLE
u32.RegisterClipboardFormatW.argtypes = [wt.LPCWSTR]
u32.RegisterClipboardFormatW.restype = wt.UINT
u32.EnumClipboardFormats.argtypes = [wt.UINT]
u32.EnumClipboardFormats.restype = wt.UINT
u32.GetClipboardFormatNameW.argtypes = [wt.UINT, wt.LPWSTR, ctypes.c_int]
u32.GetClipboardFormatNameW.restype = ctypes.c_int

k32.GlobalAlloc.argtypes = [wt.UINT, ctypes.c_size_t]
k32.GlobalAlloc.restype = wt.HANDLE
k32.GlobalLock.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE]
k32.GlobalLock.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
k32.GlobalUnlock.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE]
k32.GlobalUnlock.restype = wt.BOOL


def _alloc(data):
    h = k32.GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE, len(data))
    if not h:
        return None
    p = k32.GlobalLock(h)
    ctypes.memmove(p, data, len(data))
    k32.GlobalUnlock(h)
    return h


def build_cf_html(text):
    frag = '<html><body><!--StartFragment-->%s<!--EndFragment--></body></html>' % text
    header = ('Version:0.9\r\n'
              'StartHTML:%010d\r\n'
              'EndHTML:%010d\r\n'
              'StartFragment:%010d\r\n'
              'EndFragment:%010d\r\n')
    hdr_len = len(header % (0, 0, 0, 0))
    start_html = hdr_len
    end_html = hdr_len + len(frag)
    start_frag = hdr_len + frag.index('<!--StartFragment-->') + len('<!--StartFragment-->')
    end_frag = start_frag + len(text)
    return (header % (start_html, end_html, start_frag, end_frag) + frag).encode('utf-8')


def write_clip(text, with_html=True):
    fmt_html = u32.RegisterClipboardFormatW('HTML Format')
    for _ in range(8):
        if u32.OpenClipboard(None):
            break
        time.sleep(0.005)
    else:
        return False
    try:
        u32.EmptyClipboard()
        if with_html:
            h = _alloc(build_cf_html(text))
            if h:
                u32.SetClipboardData(fmt_html, h)
        h = _alloc((text + '\x00').encode('utf-16-le'))
        if h:
            u32.SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT, h)
        h = _alloc(ctypes.c_ulong(0x0804))
        if h:
            u32.SetClipboardData(CF_LOCALE, h)
        h = _alloc(text.encode('ascii', 'replace') + b'\x00')
        if h:
            u32.SetClipboardData(CF_TEXT, h)
        h = _alloc(text.encode('ascii', 'replace') + b'\x00')
        if h:
            u32.SetClipboardData(CF_OEMTEXT, h)
        return True
    finally:
        u32.CloseClipboard()


def read_clip():
    for _ in range(8):
        if u32.OpenClipboard(None):
            break
        time.sleep(0.005)
    else:
        return None
    try:
        h = u32.GetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT)
        if not h:
            return ''
        p = k32.GlobalLock(h)
        if not p:
            return ''
        try:
            return ctypes.wstring_at(p)
        finally:
            k32.GlobalUnlock(h)
    finally:
        u32.CloseClipboard()


def fmt_names():
    for _ in range(8):
        if u32.OpenClipboard(None):
            break
        time.sleep(0.005)
    else:
        return []
    try:
        out = []
        fid = 0
        while True:
            fid = u32.EnumClipboardFormats(fid)
            if fid == 0:
                break
            if fid < 0xC000:
                out.append('CF_%d' % fid)
            else:
                nb = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(160)
                n = u32.GetClipboardFormatNameW(fid, nb, 160)
                out.append(nb.value if n else 'REG_%d' % fid)
        return out
    finally:
        u32.CloseClipboard()


def rand_probe(n=52):
    alpha = string.ascii_uppercase + string.digits
    return 'hlg_' + ''.join(random.choice(alpha) for _ in range(n))


def one_round(text, with_html, window=1.8):
    t0 = time.time()
    if not write_clip(text, with_html):
        return None
    spent = 0.0
    while spent < window:
        time.sleep(0.02)
        spent = time.time() - t0
        cur = read_clip()
        if cur is not None and cur != text:
            return {
                'changed': True,
                'ms': int(spent * 1000),
                'len_in': len(text),
                'len_out': len(cur),
                'fmts': ','.join(fmt_names()),
            }
    return {'changed': False, 'ms': int(spent * 1000), 'len_in': len(text), 'len_out': len(text), 'fmts': ''}


def main():
    rounds = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 4
    mode = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'html'
    with_html = (mode != 'plain')
    hits = 0
    print('mode=%s rounds=%d' % ('html' if with_html else 'plain', rounds))
    for i in range(1, rounds + 1):
        p = rand_probe()
        r = one_round(p, with_html)
        if r is None:
            print('[%d] write failed' % i)
            continue
        if r['changed']:
            hits += 1
            print('[%d] REWRITTEN  +%dms  %d -> %d  fmts=%s' % (i, r['ms'], r['len_in'], r['len_out'], r['fmts']))
        else:
            print('[%d] unchanged  (%dms)' % (i, r['ms']))
    print('hits=%d/%d' % (hits, rounds))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import ctypes, ctypes.wintypes as wt, os, sys

k32 = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)

PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION = 0x0400
PROCESS_VM_READ = 0x0010
MEM_COMMIT = 0x1000
PAGE_GUARD = 0x100
PAGE_NOACCESS = 0x01

k32.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wt.DWORD, wt.BOOL, wt.DWORD]
k32.OpenProcess.restype = wt.HANDLE
k32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE]
k32.VirtualQueryEx.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
k32.VirtualQueryEx.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
k32.ReadProcessMemory.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t)]
k32.ReadProcessMemory.restype = wt.BOOL
k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, wt.DWORD, wt.LPWSTR, ctypes.POINTER(wt.DWORD)]
k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW.restype = wt.BOOL
k32.EnumProcesses = ctypes.WinDLL('psapi').EnumProcesses
k32.EnumProcesses.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(wt.DWORD), wt.DWORD, ctypes.POINTER(wt.DWORD)]
k32.EnumProcesses.restype = wt.BOOL


class MBI(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ('BaseAddress', ctypes.c_void_p),
        ('AllocationBase', ctypes.c_void_p),
        ('AllocationProtect', wt.DWORD),
        ('RegionSize', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('State', wt.DWORD),
        ('Protect', wt.DWORD),
        ('Type', wt.DWORD),
    ]


NEEDLES = [
    b'HxU6mfGNnpCsdCEmmirptobxdsNizKy1i',
    'HxU6mfGNnpCsdCEmmirptobxdsNizKy1i'.encode('utf-16-le'),
    b'Lq2fTHxU6mf',
    'Lq2fTHxU6mf'.encode('utf-16-le'),
]


def pids():
    arr = (wt.DWORD * 4096)()
    used = wt.DWORD(0)
    if not k32.EnumProcesses(arr, ctypes.sizeof(arr), ctypes.byref(used)):
        return []
    n = used.value // ctypes.sizeof(wt.DWORD)
    return [arr[i] for i in range(n)]


def name_of(h):
    buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(520)
    size = wt.DWORD(520)
    if k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW(h, 0, buf, ctypes.byref(size)):
        return buf.value
    return ''


def scan(pid, cap=1600 * 1024 * 1024):
    h = k32.OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ, False, pid)
    if not h:
        return None
    hits = []
    try:
        addr = 0
        total = 0
        mbi = MBI()
        while total < cap:
            got = k32.VirtualQueryEx(h, ctypes.c_void_p(addr), ctypes.byref(mbi), ctypes.sizeof(mbi))
            if not got:
                break
            base = mbi.BaseAddress or 0
            size = mbi.RegionSize or 0
            if size == 0:
                break
            if (mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT and not (mbi.Protect & PAGE_GUARD)
                    and not (mbi.Protect & PAGE_NOACCESS) and mbi.Protect != 0):
                chunk = 4 * 1024 * 1024
                off = 0
                while off < size:
                    n = min(chunk, size - off)
                    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(n)
                    read = ctypes.c_size_t(0)
                    if k32.ReadProcessMemory(h, ctypes.c_void_p(base + off), buf, n, ctypes.byref(read)):
                        data = buf.raw[:read.value]
                        total += len(data)
                        for nd in NEEDLES:
                            if nd in data:
                                hits.append((nd[:6].decode('ascii', 'replace'), base + off + data.find(nd)))
                                break
                    off += n
                    if total >= cap:
                        break
            addr = base + size
    finally:
        k32.CloseHandle(h)
    return hits


def main():
    me = os.getpid()
    found = []
    denied = []
    for pid in pids():
        if pid == 0 or pid == me:
            continue
        h = k32.OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ, False, pid)
        if not h:
            h2 = k32.OpenProcess(0x1000, False, pid)
            nm = name_of(h2) if h2 else ''
            if h2:
                k32.CloseHandle(h2)
            if nm:
                denied.append((pid, os.path.basename(nm)))
            continue
        nm = name_of(h)
        k32.CloseHandle(h)
        if not nm:
            continue
        hits = scan(pid)
        if hits is None:
            denied.append((pid, os.path.basename(nm)))
            continue
        if hits:
            found.append((pid, os.path.basename(nm), hits))
            print('HIT  pid=%-7d %-28s %s' % (pid, os.path.basename(nm), hits), flush=True)
    print('\n=== FOUND %d ===' % len(found))
    for pid, nm, hits in found:
        print('  pid=%-7d %-30s %s' % (pid, nm, hits))
    print('\n=== DENIED %d ===' % len(denied))
    for pid, nm in sorted(denied, key=lambda x: x[1]):
        print('  pid=%-7d %s' % (pid, nm))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

content.text:
Interesting entries I hadn't seen before:
- `FFWallpaper.exe` / `WallPaper.exe` in `C:\Users\wk\AppData\Local\Bin\` — suspicious location! "Bin" in AppData\Local with two wallpaper apps. Could be壁纸软件. Hmm, "FFWallpaper" —火绒? No. Could be飞火壁纸?
- `extension-host.exe` in `.codex\plugins\cache\openai-bundled\chrome\latest\extension-host\windows\x64\` — this is a **Chrome extension host** for the Codex plugin! That's very interesting: a browser-extension host that might interact with clipboard.
- `tailscale-ipn` — VPN.
- `Clash for Windows` — proxy.
- `PhoneExperienceHost` —手机连接 (Phone Link)! Phone Link has **clipboard sync** between phone and PC! That could explain a clipboard rewrite!! But it would replace with phone clipboard content, not a fixed token.
- `MSPCManager` —微软电脑管家.
- `Video.UI`, `PushNotificationsLongRunningTask`.
- `WeChatAppEx` x20, `WeChatPlayer`, `WeChatOCR`, `WeChatUtility`.
- `douyin` + `douyin_guard`.
- `promecefpluginhost`, `wps`, `wpscloudsvr` — WPS has云剪贴板? WPS has "云同步" and possibly clipboard.
- `ArdotBridge`, `font-helper`.
- `editor_sdk`.
- `betterleaks`, `sandbox-center`, `sandbox-cli` — WorkBuddy's sandbox.

Now, the key: **`extension-host.exe` from codex plugins cache, "openai-bundled/chrome"**. A Chrome extension host — Chrome extensions can read/write the clipboard! And "openai-bundled" suggests a bundled Chrome extension for the Codex CLI. Hmm! If there's a Chrome extension that does clipboard manipulation, that could be it.

Wait, but user said copying in VSCode also triggers. A browser extension wouldn't touch VSCode clipboard unless it's a native host.

Hmm, `extension-host.exe` is a *native* process though. It could be a native messaging host.

Hmm, but let's think about `FFWallpaper.exe` in `AppData\Local\Bin` — that's an odd path (usually wallpapers install in Program Files). "FFWallpaper" might be a repackaged/unofficial wallpaper tool. Malware often installs to AppData\Local\Bin.

Honestly, a fixed34-char base62 token inserted into clipboard content is a hallmark of... hmm.

Let me think about "hlg_". Could `hlg_` be a key prefix used by **火绒**? Or by "Halo"?Hmm — what about **豆包/Doubao**? Earlier excluded.

What about **抖音 (douyin)** + **douyin_guard**? Douyin PC client is running. Douyin has clipboard detection ("复制链接打开抖音"). douyin_guard might be the guard process. Earlier "抖音守护" was excluded by suspension.

Hmm, but that exclusion used the unreliable method.

OK. Let me take the decisive approach now: **suspend-based bisect with the rig**, but automate it so it's fast and statistical.

Actually — better idea!!! **Capture the culprit's HWND via aggressive polling.** Since the rewrite writes with OpenClipboard(NULL), GetOpenClipboardWindow won't help.

BUT: there's another angle — when a process calls SetClipboardData, Windows records it. `GetClipboardOwner()` returns0 for OpenClipboard(NULL). HOWEVER, `GetClipboardSequenceNumber` we know.

Hmm.

Alternative decisive approach: **ETW kernel provider "Microsoft-Windows-Win32k"**? Not for clipboard.

OK, what about this: **hooking via a "Clipboard Format Listener"** won't identify.

Practical: let's do the suspension bisect, but choose a **strong trigger**. Let me first improve hit rate: try writing with a *real* CF_HTML plus more formats and see. Also try window=6s to catch delayed timer-based reactions.

Let me run: `python tmp-rig.py8 html` with window default1.8 — no, let me add window param. Simpler: run a quick experiment with6s window by editing default.

Actually, let me reconsider the intermittency cause from data:
- Round1 hit at +252ms- Round4 hit at +376ms- Round3 (earlier run) hit at +271msTimes: r1 t≈0.25s, r4 t≈5.6s. Rounds run every ~1.85s. So hits at "round1" and "round4" — i.e.,3 rounds apart. In the earlier run: hit at round3 only.

Hmm no clear period.

Wait, maybe the culprit only rewrites when the clipboard content is **not already seen**. Each probe is unique though.

Alternatively — maybe it rewrites only when **the previous clipboard content differed in a specific way**...

Alternatively the culprit might have a **debounce of ~5s**: hit at r1 (t=0), then r4 (t=5.6). Gap5.6s ≈5s debounce! And rounds5-10 (t=7.4..17) — should have hit again at t≈10.6 (r6?) — no hit. Hmm.

I'm going in circles. Let me get empirical with a bigger sample and a longer window, and log timing to detect periodicity.

Plan: modify rig to do12 rounds with3.0s window, print hit times. Total ~36s. Then analyze gaps.

Hmm, time budget. The user is waiting. Let me think about what the user actually wants: "which program writes it".Maybe I should just be honest and propose the definitive experiment that requires their action: **clean boot / safe mode** or **msconfig bisect**. That's the classic, guaranteed way: disable startup items in halves.

Actually — given the difficulty, THE most reliable method now: **Autoruns-style bisect**: disable all third-party startup entries, reboot, test; if clean, re-enable half at a time. Guaranteed to find it, but needs reboots and user time.

Alternatively use "干净启动" (msconfig). Reasonable to propose.

But before that, let me try one more automated approach that could nail it in one shot: **catch the process at the exact moment it holds the clipboard open**, by hammering OpenClipboard in a tight loop and, on failure, calling GetOpenClipboardWindow() and GetClipboardOwner(). Even if the writer uses OpenClipboard(NULL), during the open period `GetOpenClipboardWindow` returns... the window that opened it; NULL if none. So no.

Hmm. What about **NtUserGetClipboardOwner**? no.

OK — alternative: **watch for the process's window/thread activity**: enumerate all top-level + message-only windows and their PIDs; right after a rewrite, check which process's thread had recent activity? Not reliable.

Another idea: **Use Windows "Clipboard" ETW?** There is `Microsoft-Windows-Runtime-WebAPI`? no.

Kernel ETW provider `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Object`? no.

OK, decision: go with the **suspension bisect**, but make it cheap by suspending **many processes at once in halves** using the rig to test. The rig hit rate ~20% per round means we need ~10 rounds (~18s) per configuration to be reasonably sure. With5 configurations that's90s+. Acceptable, but we need admin for elevated processes — those are exactly the interesting ones (TrafficMonitor denied). Hmm, but we can test non-elevated groups first.

Actually — hmm, wait. Let me reconsider something important. Is it possible the culprit is **not a separate process** but a **driver / kernel filter** (e.g., a keyboard filter driver from a game security tool)? A kernel driver can't easily write clipboard text... it would need a user-mode helper.

Also possible: an **IME (输入法)**. ChsIME/ctfmon are Microsoft. Is there a third-party IME? Not in list (no Sogou).Hmm what about `font-helper.exe` from Ardot? Odd. `ArdotBridge.exe`?

Let me look at `AppData\Local\Bin\FFWallpaper.exe` and `extension-host.exe` more closely — file signatures/company. That's cheap and could be revealing. A wallpaper app that does clipboard stuff = likely adware/promo tool.

Actually!!! Wait. **FFWallpaper / WallPaper in AppData\Local\Bin** — "FF" could be "飞火" or... Many Chinese wallpaper tools bundle "桌面助手" with clipboard hijack features. And the pattern "insert a fixed token" is odd for them though.

Let me check digital signatures + version info for these two, and for extension-host.exe. Cheap: Get-Item VersionInfo.

Let me also reconsider: the inserted constant `Lq2fTHxU6mfGNnpCsdCEmmirptobxdsNizKy1i`. Hmm...34-45 chars base62. What if it's a **promo/affiliate code** injected into clipboard? Some Chinese adware injects promo codes/links. But inserting into a key?

Hmm, OR: it could be **a "watermark" that a clipboard manager adds**? no.

OK let me just check file metadata of the suspicious ones, then decide. Also check signature.

Let me run a quick version-info dump on: FFWallpaper.exe, WallPaper.exe, extension-host.exe, betterleaks.exe, font-helper.exe, TrafficMonitor (denied path?), DwarfAxe.

Also list autostart entries (Run keys + startup folder + scheduled tasks referencing non-MS paths) — that gives the candidate set for bisect.

Let me do that.
进程列表里有几个之前没注意的东西，尤其 `C:\Users\wk\AppData\Local\Bin\` 下的 `FFWallpaper.exe` / `WallPaper.exe`，还有 `.codex` 里的 `extension-host.exe`。我看一眼它们的来源和签名，同时把开机自启项拉出来。

def _alloc(data):

def build_cf_html(text):
    frag = '<html><body><!--StartFragment-->%s<!--EndFragment--></body></html>' % text
    header = ('Version:0.9\r\nStartHTML:%010d\r\nEndHTML:%010d\r\n'
              'StartFragment:%010d\r\nEndFragment:%010d\r\n')
    hl = len(header % (0, 0, 0, 0))
    sf = hl + frag.index('<!--StartFragment-->') + len('<!--StartFragment-->')
    return (header % (hl, hl + len(frag), sf, sf + len(text)) + frag).encode('utf-8')

    frag = '<html><body><!--StartFragment-->%s<!--EndFragment--></body></html>' % text

              'StartFragment:%010d\r\nEndFragment:%010d\r\n')

              'StartFragment:%010d\r\nEndFragment:%010d\r\n')
    hl = len(header % (0, 0, 0, 0))

import ctypes, ctypes.wintypes as wt, os, sys, re

k32 = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)
psapi = ctypes.WinDLL('psapi', use_last_error=True)

PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, PROCESS_VM_READ = 0x0400, 0x0010
MEM_COMMIT, MEM_PRIVATE, MEM_IMAGE, MEM_MAPPED = 0x1000, 0x20000, 0x1000000, 0x40000
PAGE_GUARD, PAGE_NOACCESS = 0x100, 0x01
EXEC_PROTECT = {0x10: 'EXECUTE', 0x20: 'EXECUTE_READ', 0x40: 'EXECUTE_READWRITE', 0x80: 'EXECUTE_WRITECOPY'}

k32.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wt.DWORD, wt.BOOL, wt.DWORD]
k32.OpenProcess.restype = wt.HANDLE
k32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE]
k32.VirtualQueryEx.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
k32.VirtualQueryEx.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
k32.ReadProcessMemory.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t)]
k32.ReadProcessMemory.restype = wt.BOOL
k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, wt.DWORD, wt.LPWSTR, ctypes.POINTER(wt.DWORD)]
k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW.restype = wt.BOOL
k32.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot.argtypes = [wt.DWORD, wt.DWORD]
k32.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot.restype = wt.HANDLE
k32.Thread32First.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, ctypes.c_void_p]
k32.Thread32First.restype = wt.BOOL
k32.Thread32Next.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, ctypes.c_void_p]
k32.Thread32Next.restype = wt.BOOL
k32.OpenThread.argtypes = [wt.DWORD, wt.BOOL, wt.DWORD]
k32.OpenThread.restype = wt.HANDLE

ntdll = ctypes.WinDLL('ntdll', use_last_error=True)
ntdll.NtQueryInformationThread.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p, wt.ULONG, ctypes.POINTER(wt.ULONG)]
ntdll.NtQueryInformationThread.restype = ctypes.c_long


class MBI(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('BaseAddress', ctypes.c_void_p), ('AllocationBase', ctypes.c_void_p),
                ('AllocationProtect', wt.DWORD), ('RegionSize', ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('State', wt.DWORD), ('Protect', wt.DWORD), ('Type', wt.DWORD)]


class THREADENTRY32(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('dwSize', wt.DWORD), ('cntUsage', wt.DWORD), ('th32ThreadID', wt.DWORD),
                ('th32OwnerProcessID', wt.DWORD), ('tpBasePri', ctypes.c_long),
                ('tpDeltaPri', ctypes.c_long), ('dwFlags', wt.DWORD)]


def find_pid(name):
    arr = (wt.DWORD * 4096)()
    used = wt.DWORD(0)
    psapi.EnumProcesses(arr, ctypes.sizeof(arr), ctypes.byref(used))
    out = []
    for i in range(used.value // ctypes.sizeof(wt.DWORD)):
        pid = arr[i]
        if pid == 0:
            continue
        h = k32.OpenProcess(0x1000, False, pid)
        if not h:
            continue
        try:
            buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(520)
            size = wt.DWORD(520)
            if k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW(h, 0, buf, ctypes.byref(size)):
                if os.path.basename(buf.value).lower() == name.lower():
                    out.append(pid)
        finally:
            k32.CloseHandle(h)
    return out


def regions(h):
    addr = 0
    mbi = MBI()
    out = []
    while k32.VirtualQueryEx(h, ctypes.c_void_p(addr), ctypes.byref(mbi), ctypes.sizeof(mbi)):
        base = mbi.BaseAddress or 0
        size = mbi.RegionSize or 0
        if size == 0:
            break
        out.append((base, size, mbi.State, mbi.Protect, mbi.Type, mbi.AllocationBase))
        addr = base + size
        if addr > 0x7FFFFFFFFFFF:
            break
    return out


def read_mem(h, base, size, cap=1 << 20):
    n = min(size, cap)
    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(n)
    got = ctypes.c_size_t(0)
    if not k32.ReadProcessMemory(h, ctypes.c_void_p(base), buf, n, ctypes.byref(got)):
        return b''
    return buf.raw[:got.value]


def thread_starts(pid):
    snap = k32.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(0x00000004, 0)
    if snap in (0, -1, None):
        return []
    res = []
    te = THREADENTRY32()
    te.dwSize = ctypes.sizeof(THREADENTRY32)
    ok = k32.Thread32First(snap, ctypes.byref(te))
    while ok:
        if te.th32OwnerProcessID == pid:
            th = k32.OpenThread(0x0040, False, te.th32ThreadID)
            if th:
                try:
                    addr = ctypes.c_void_p(0)
                    ret = wt.ULONG(0)
                    if ntdll.NtQueryInformationThread(th, 9, ctypes.byref(addr), ctypes.sizeof(addr), ctypes.byref(ret)) == 0:
                        res.append((te.th32ThreadID, addr.value or 0))
                finally:
                    k32.CloseHandle(th)
        ok = k32.Thread32Next(snap, ctypes.byref(te))
    k32.CloseHandle(snap)
    return res


def main():
    name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'UserAccountBroker.exe'
    pids = find_pid(name)
    if not pids:
        print('not running:', name)
        return
    for pid in pids:
        print('=== %s pid=%d ===' % (name, pid))
        h = k32.OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ, False, pid)
        if not h:
            print('  open failed')
            continue
        try:
            regs = regions(h)
            print('  regions=%d' % len(regs))
            print('  --- private executable regions (injection candidates) ---')
            private_exec = []
            for base, size, state, prot, typ, alloc in regs:
                if state != MEM_COMMIT:
                    continue
                if typ != MEM_PRIVATE:
                    continue
                p = prot & 0xFF
                if p in EXEC_PROTECT:
                    private_exec.append((base, size, p))
                    data = read_mem(h, base, size, 4096)
                    strs = [s.decode('ascii', 'replace') for s in re.findall(rb'[\x20-\x7e]{6,}', data)]
                    print('    base=0x%X size=%-10d %-18s strings=%r' % (base, size, EXEC_PROTECT[p], strs[:6]))
            if not private_exec:
                print('    (none)')
            print('  --- threads with start address in private exec region ---')
            starts = thread_starts(pid)
            print('    threads=%d' % len(starts))
            for tid, sa in starts:
                inside = None
                for base, size, p in private_exec:
                    if base <= sa < base + size:
                        inside = (base, size)
                        break
                if inside:
                    print('      tid=%-7d start=0x%X  INSIDE private region base=0x%X' % (tid, sa, inside[0]))
        finally:
            k32.CloseHandle(h)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

k32 = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)
psapi = ctypes.WinDLL('psapi', use_last_error=True)

k32.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wt.DWORD, wt.BOOL, wt.DWORD]
k32.OpenProcess.restype = wt.HANDLE
k32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE]
k32.ReadProcessMemory.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t)]
k32.ReadProcessMemory.restype = wt.BOOL
k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, wt.DWORD, wt.LPWSTR, ctypes.POINTER(wt.DWORD)]
k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW.restype = wt.BOOL
psapi.EnumProcesses.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(wt.DWORD), wt.DWORD, ctypes.POINTER(wt.DWORD)]
psapi.EnumProcesses.restype = wt.BOOL

TARGETS = [(0x19004580000, 831488), (0x19004A00000, 839680)]


def find_pid(name):
    arr = (wt.DWORD * 4096)()
    used = wt.DWORD(0)
    psapi.EnumProcesses(arr, ctypes.sizeof(arr), ctypes.byref(used))
    for i in range(used.value // ctypes.sizeof(wt.DWORD)):
        pid = arr[i]
        if pid == 0:
            continue
        h = k32.OpenProcess(0x1000, False, pid)
        if not h:
            continue
        try:
            buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(520)
            size = wt.DWORD(520)
            if k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW(h, 0, buf, ctypes.byref(size)):
                if os.path.basename(buf.value).lower() == name.lower():
                    return pid
        finally:
            k32.CloseHandle(h)
    return None


def read_mem(h, base, size):
    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(size)
    got = ctypes.c_size_t(0)
    if not k32.ReadProcessMemory(h, ctypes.c_void_p(base), buf, size, ctypes.byref(got)):
        return b''
    return buf.raw[:got.value]


def pe_info(d):
    if len(d) < 0x100 or d[:2] != b'MZ':
        return None
    e_lfanew = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, 0x3C)[0]
    if d[e_lfanew:e_lfanew + 4] != b'PE\0\0':
        return None
    machine, nsec, ts = struct.unpack_from('<HHI', d, e_lfanew + 4)
    magic = struct.unpack_from('<H', d, e_lfanew + 24)[0]
    info = {'machine': hex(machine), 'sections': nsec, 'timestamp': ts, 'magic': hex(magic), 'sect': []}
    off = e_lfanew + 24 + (0xF0 if magic == 0x20B else 0xE0)
    for i in range(nsec):
        s = d[off + i * 40: off + i * 40 + 40]
        if len(s) < 40:
            break
        nm = s[:8].rstrip(b'\x00').decode('ascii', 'replace')
        vsize, vaddr, rsize, raddr = struct.unpack_from('<IIII', s, 8)
        info['sect'].append((nm, hex(vaddr), vsize, raddr, rsize))
    return info


def strings(d, minlen=6):
    out = set()
    for m in re.finditer(rb'[\x20-\x7e]{%d,}' % minlen, d):
        out.add(m.group().decode('ascii', 'replace'))
    for m in re.finditer(('(?:[\x20-\x7e]\x00){%d,}' % minlen).encode(), d):
        try:
            out.add(m.group().decode('utf-16-le', 'replace'))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return out


def main():
    name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'UserAccountBroker.exe'
    pid = find_pid(name)
    if not pid:
        print('not running')
        return
    h = k32.OpenProcess(0x0400 | 0x0010, False, pid)
    if not h:
        print('open failed')
        return
    try:
        for i, (base, size) in enumerate(TARGETS):
            d = read_mem(h, base, size)
            out = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'tmp-dump-%d.bin' % i)
            with open(out, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(d)
            print('\n===== region %d base=0x%X size=%d read=%d =====' % (i, base, size, len(d)))
            pi = pe_info(d)
            if pi:
                print('PE machine=%s sections=%d magic=%s ts=%s' % (pi['machine'], pi['sections'], pi['magic'], pi['timestamp']))
                for s in pi['sect']:
                    print('   sect %-8s vaddr=%-10s vsize=%-8d raw_off=%-8d raw_size=%d' % s)
            else:
                print('not a PE header at base')
            ss = strings(d)
            kw = re.compile(r'clip|hlg|Lq2f|pdb|\.dll|\.exe|Shanda|sdo|盛趣|Tencent|keylog|hook|inject|gpk', re.I)
            sel = sorted(x for x in ss if kw.search(x))
            print('strings total=%d matched=%d' % (len(ss), len(sel)))
            for x in sel[:70]:
                print('   ', x[:120])
    finally:
        k32.CloseHandle(h)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

MAJOR FINDING:

```
[Running] \Microsoft\Windows\WwanSvc\CreateDesktopShellUnelevatedS C:\Users\wk\AppData\Local\Bin\FFWallpaper.exe[Ready] \Microsoft\Windows\WwanSvc\CreateDesktopShellUnelevatedW C:\Users\wk\AppData\Local\Bin\FFWallpaper.exe```

This is the classic **task masquerading** technique: malicious tasks created inside `\Microsoft\Windows\WwanSvc\` (a legitimate-looking system path) but launching `FFWallpaper.exe` from AppData\Local\Bin!

The legit WwanSvc tasks are `NotificationTask` etc. The malware added two tasks named `CreateDesktopShellUnelevatedS` and `CreateDesktopShellUnelevatedW` under the Microsoft\Windows\WwanSvc namespace — mimicking legit naming, so most tools won't flag them.

So `FFWallpaper.exe` is the loader, and it's launched both via:
- HKCU Run: `Support` → FFWallpaper.exe- Task: `\Microsoft\Windows\WwanSvc\CreateDesktopShellUnelevatedS` → FFWallpaper.exeAnd FFWallpaper.exe is15KB, unpacks6.8MB RWX region.

Wait, but earlier I dumped FFWallpaper's6.8MB region and found no matching markers (no360Tray.exe etc.). Hmm. But maybe the6.8MB region is just a packed resource and the actual injected payload is elsewhere, or FFWallpaper is a downloader.

Hmm, actually: maybe FFWallpaper.exe's6.8MB region contains a **packed** payload that gets further decrypted. Or FFWallpaper is a launcher that downloads and runs.

Still — the task masquerading is damning. Let me examine:
1. The two tasks' XML: author, date created, arguments.
2. `C:\Windows\System32\Tasks\Microsoft\Windows\WwanSvc\` folder listing with timestamps — the task files' creation times give the infection date!
3. FFWallpaper.exe details: signature? company? (earlier VersionInfo was empty, size15360, and signature check errored because Test-Path failed oddly).

Let me check the task folder timestamps — that's the money shot for "when did this happen".

Also compare with the legitimate WwanSvc tasks' timestamps (should be2025/1/1 like the OS install).

Let me run:
- List `C:\Windows\System32\Tasks\Microsoft\Windows\WwanSvc` with Created/Modified- Export XML of both tasks- FFWallpaper.exe signature/hash/version + parentLet's go.

This is the answer to "哪里引入的" — at least the persistence. The actual entry vector (how it got installed) may still be unknown, but FFWallpaper (a "wallpaper" app) is the payload host. Combined with `\UserTask` (zfon.exe) — two separate infections or one family.

Let me gather.

**抓到了。** 有两条任务藏在系统命名空间里伪装：

```
\Microsoft\Windows\WwanSvc\CreateDesktopShellUnelevatedS  →  C:\Users\wk\AppData\Local\Bin\FFWallpaper.exe   [Running]
\Microsoft\Windows\WwanSvc\CreateDesktopShellUnelevatedW  →  同上
```

正常的 `WwanSvc` 目录里只有 `NotificationTask`，这两条是**冒充系统任务**插进去的，从名字到路径都刻意做得像系统组件。而且它和注册表 Run 项里的 `Support` 指向同一个文件——**双保险自启**。

我看这两条任务的注册时间和那个 15KB 的程序。

Excellent, this is now very conclusive:

**The two tasks were created2026/4/2019:31:44** — while every legitimate task in that folder is2025/1/1 (OS install). So the infection happened on **2026年4月20日19:31**.

Interesting: earlier in the `C:\Users\wk\AppData\Local\Bin` listing, the directories `ca-ES`, `cs-CZ`, `res`, `Sysdiag` all had `2026/4/2019:31:44` — **exactly the same timestamp**! That confirms the infection time and that this folder was modified at that moment.

FFWallpaper.exe:
- Size15360- Created/Modified2026/4/7 (before infection — hmm, so the file predates the task creation by13 days)
- Description = **"CLT Community"** — that's a known thing: "CLT Community" is associated with... hmm. Actually "CLT Community" appears in some Chinese "绿盾"? Hmm.
- **NotSigned** — unsigned binary in AppData, generic version info "CLT Community".
- Task runs with `RunLevel: HighestAvailable` and `Hidden: true`, logon trigger repeating every1 minute.

This is definitively malicious persistence:
- Hidden task- Masquerading as Microsoft\Windows\WwanSvc- Author = DESKTOP-MIEN538\wk (the user's own account)
- HighestAvailable privileges- Repeats every minute- Payload in AppData\Local\Bin, unsigned, description "CLT Community"

Also the second task has `RegistrationTrigger` with1-minute delay — so re-registering triggers it.

So: **the source is FFWallpaper.exe** (an unsigned15KB loader in AppData\Local\Bin, described as "CLT Community"), which was set to auto-start on2026/4/2019:31.

Now, how did it get there originally? File created2026/4/715:38. Something installed it on4/7. What was installed around then? We could check:
- Installed programs (uninstall registry) with InstallDate around2026-04-07- Browser download history?- Other files created2026-04-07 in that dirThe Bin folder also has `stardict-editor.dll` (4/13), `config.ini` (4/13), history.html/js etc (2025/10/22) — that looks like a **dictionary/translation tool** ("CLT Community" — hmm, CLT = ?). Actually "CLT Community" + stardict + history.html + jedate + jquery → this looks like the **"词典/翻译" app** or a wallpaper app with a built-in web UI.

Hmm — "FFWallpaper" but description "CLT Community". And there's `360AppCore.exe`, `360Desktop.exe`, `Sysdiag` — leftovers from360.

Let me check installed programs with install dates around2026/4/7 and2026/4/20.

That would answer "哪里引入的".

Also worth: check `WallPaper.exe` — child of FFWallpaper, started7:08:05 (6 min after). Interesting: FFWallpaper spawns WallPaper.exe. Two15KB binaries.

Let me look at what else in AppData\Local was created around4/7 and4/20.

Plan:
1. Query registry Uninstall keys for InstallDate around2026-04.
2. List files in AppData\Local created/modified on2026/4/7 and2026/4/20 (top-level dirs).
3. Check Downloads folder for files around those dates.

That should pin the entry vector.

Let me run these.

Also: the DNS/hostname is DESKTOP-MIEN538.

Let me do it.

Note: querying all files by date across C: is slow. Let me limit to AppData\Local top-level dirs and Downloads, and registry uninstall entries.

Let me run.

**时间线锁定了。** 这两条任务创建于 **2026/4/20 19:31:44**，而同一目录里所有正规系统任务都是 **2025/1/1**（系统装好的时间）。也就是说，感染发生在 **2026 年 4 月 20 日晚上 7 点半**。

那个程序本身的特征也很清楚：

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 大小 | 15,360 字节 |
| 签名 | **无签名（NotSigned）** |
| 描述 | `CLT Community` |
| 位置 | `C:\Users\wk\AppData\Local\Bin\` |
| 任务权限 | `HighestAvailable`（最高权限）、**`Hidden=true`（隐藏）** |

另外注意：`Bin` 目录里的 `Sysdiag`、`res`、`ca-ES`、`cs-CZ` 四个文件夹的时间戳**也正好是 2026/4/20 19:31:44**，是同一时刻被写进去的。

现在往上追：4 月 7 日这个文件落地、4 月 20 日装上自启动，看看那几天装了什么。
